acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan and the Reviews that implement it reference each other, and a Plan can have more than one.
The comparison shows the planned work beside what the Reviews delivered, identifying planned work that no Review delivered and delivered work the Plan did not include.

content.statement: As a developer, I can see a Plan side by side with the Review or Reviews that implement it, so I can judge how what we did differs from what we said we would do.
content.title: Compare what we said with what we did

state.reason: Verified against the code and tests on 2026-11-02. A Plan and its Reviews link both ways, and the comparison names what no Review delivered and what the Plan did not include.
